clause: SEC-3.1: Surgical treatments including appendectomy, joint replacements, and coronary interventions are covered up to the sum insured of INR 500,000, subject to standard pre-authorization.
SEC-4.2: Cataract surgery carries a strict sub-limit of INR 40,000 per eye. Claims exceeding this limit shall be approved only up to the sub-limit ceiling.
SEC-5.1: Pre-existing conditions and joint replacement procedures carry a mandatory waiting period of 24 consecutive months from policy inception.
SEC-6.1: Cosmetic surgeries, experimental treatments, and unverified alternative therapies are strictly excluded from coverage.
